# Workspaces: named sets of tabs in one window; the others' programs run on.
type:echo ONE-HERE; sleep 2; echo ONE-STILL-GOING
key:enter
wait:0.4
expect-workspace:[Default]
# A second workspace: its own shell, its own tabs.
workspace:new:Build
expect-workspace:Default [Build]
type:echo BUILD-SHELL
key:enter
wait:0.6
expect:BUILD-SHELL
tab:new
wait:0.5
# What ran in the first one while we were away.
wait:2.0
expect:ONE-STILL-GOING
# Back to the first: one tab (the second workspace's two don't show).
workspace:1
expect-workspace:[Default] Build
type:echo BACK-IN-ONE
key:enter
wait:0.6
expect:BACK-IN-ONE
# The palette lists them; picking one shows it.
key:cmd+shift+p
wait:0.4
type:build
wait:0.3
expect-palette:Build
key:enter
wait:0.8
expect-workspace:Default [Build]
# Saved and built again: the same workspaces, tabs and (parked, floating) panes.
key:cmd+d
wait:0.8
key:cmd+shift+p
wait:0.4
type:float pane
wait:0.3
key:enter
wait:0.8
expect-float:yes
roundtrip:go
key:cmd+shift+p
wait:0.4
type:float pane
wait:0.3
key:enter
wait:0.8
# Closing the last tab's pane of a workspace ends it, and the window shows the other.
workspace:close
wait:0.6
expect-workspace:[Default]
shot:workspaces.png
# Closing a workspace's last tab closes the workspace; Undo brings it back.
workspace:new:Temp
expect-workspace:=Default [Temp]
key:cmd+w
wait:0.8
expect-workspace:=[Default]
undo:go
wait:0.8
expect-workspace:=Default [Temp]
# A tab closed in one workspace comes back there, Undo pressed from another.
tab:new
wait:0.6
expect-tab-count:2
key:cmd+w
wait:0.8
expect-tab-count:1
workspace:1
expect-workspace:=[Default] Temp
undo:go
wait:0.8
expect-workspace:=Default [Temp]
expect-tab-count:2
